verdict.rationale: Mintlify's docs say it automatically generates both llms.txt and llms-full.txt so AI tools can index published documentation. A live probe returned HTTP 200 for llms.txt, and llms.txt files are also served at /docs/llms.txt and /blog/llms.txt; a blog post adds that generation now uses a hierarchy of files so agents can reach every page. Missing for 10: hands-on verification that llms-full.txt is actually served, and independent or community corroboration.
